notes: Adds shared CommonMark/GFM rendering for notes and transcripts, offline bundled Mermaid diagrams, iOS brand colors and Inter fonts, light/dark appearance settings, avatar catalog with agent-list and conversation attribution, local attention/question/completion notification channels and permission settings, unified connection/appearance/notification/diagnostics settings, host-filtered creation choices and workspace creation, and source-to-destination workspace transfer with preview, owner/version/collision checks, validated chunks, and commit uncertainty handling. Earlier Tailcat, recovery, workspace, note, task, comment, attachment, Git, terminal, and browser features remain. Android is unreleased. Local alerts require a connected process; Android can suspend it in the background. Notifications observe the active connection only; cross-backend notification taps do not switch hosts. Transfer runs to completion once started; cancellation UI and transfer progress detail remain follow-ups. Workspace creation currently supports a host repository path, base branch, prompt, provider/model, and specialist; richer repository pickers and media inputs remain under development. Native permission dialogs, background delivery, notification taps, transfer against live hosts, WebView gestures, launcher appearance, and diagnostics sharing still need device verification. Note editing, full VT rendering, video import, conversation model switching, and remaining iOS features are under development. Conversation polish adds collapsed thinking/tool disclosures, pull-to-refresh, automatic older-history loading, gesture-controlled tail following with a new-messages pill, and an attachment icon inline with the message input. Agent names and timestamps use one small muted metadata line. Removes transcript status and auto-scroll buttons. The companion chrome change consolidates headers and moves workspace and connection actions into overflow menus. Android remains unreleased. Suggested prompts follow the shared canonical parser cases, hide raw blocks, and prefill the composer through chips without sending. Agent messages and other coordination traffic use muted expandable transcript entries; queued background updates share a collapsed disclosure. Live Pixel checks and API34 Compose tests cover conversation behavior; API37 Espresso input reflection is incompatible with the current test framework. Workspace list presentation now uses separated cards, prominent titles, two-line status messages, and compact lifecycle/work-state badges, following the iOS workspace hierarchy with existing Android theme tokens.
